title: China’s Alibaba takes another swipe at America’s AI supremacy
slides: Can Alibaba's new model dethrone America's AI lead?

Test its open weights against your current model today.

1. Can Alibaba dethrone America?

A new model matches top US systems in key benchmarks, but runs on older, cheaper chips.

2. Cost-performance shift

US developers face a serious threat because this model delivers comparable results at a fraction of the cost.

instagram.caption:
A model matching America’s top AI systems on key benchmarks is running on older, cheaper chips — not cutting-edge hardware.  

Alibaba just released this open-source model, and the cost-performance gap is the story. US developers can now get comparable results for a fraction of the spend, without waiting for the newest supply chain. The open weights mean you can run it yourself today.  

This changes your math on tooling. If you pay a premium for a US model, you can now A/B test the same prompt on Alibaba’s weights and check the speed and the bill.  

Does your current model justify its price when the alternative runs leaner? ⚖️💻📉
